note: Banque Misr's schedule of charges for individual accounts (effective 1 July 2026): a local-currency current account opens with 2,500 pounds and is charged 30 pounds a month when its balance falls below that. Its statement fee per cycle (150 pounds inside Egypt) names no cycle, so it isn't modelled.

sources.title: Banque Misr, Schedule of Charges: Individual Accounts (effective 1st July 2026)
sources.said: Effective 1st July 2026 ... EGP 30 Monthly (if the required EGP EGP 2500 balance falls below ... EGP 2,500)
